title: Parable of the Sower
author: Octavia E. Butler
review:
Loved this overall. Dystopian book that takes place in 2024-2027 so it was kind of cool to read it in the year it takes place and it's eerily prescient. Butler has an amazing authorial voice that is somehow simultaneously bleak, heavy, angry, but has glimmers of hope. I got Walking Dead and The Stand vibes from this.

The world building details kind of don't make 100% sense but they're not really the focus and it was easy for me to suspend my disbelief a bit but yeah, not completely bought into how the world ended up in this state of disrepair and didn't totally collapse, but that's mainly a background to a more zoomed in and personal narrative.
